normal_required_fields.os_evidence: Actual uid/euid/uid_map/gid_map, child IPC/mount namespace IDs, private and expected-host dev/ino, quota and longest-covering mount records for dev/shm/alias/tmp

interface.negative_required_fields: FAILED at exact admission stage/error, semaphore_cleanup.created false, close/unlink NOT_OWNED, directory_close_errors empty. No private result/witness/sem creation; stdout is retained separately by collector.
interface.parsing: Require exact actual tool exit plus expected mode/status/cleanup and complete collector archive where applicable. A saved PASSED report alone cannot override a nonzero exit or finalization error.

isolation_and_bounds.before_creation: Validate namespace difference, real directory descriptors opened O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW, private/alias dev+ino equality, private/host inequality, directory0700/effective-UID ownership, TMPDIR device equality and existing output quota. Record mount evidence and require /dev ro, exact /dev/shm rw/tmpfs and alias ro.
isolation_and_bounds.host_absence: Collector/root must read-only check wl-ipc-<token>.witness and sem.wl-ipc-<token> ABSENT on actual host /dev/shm before and after, bind host dev/ino into environment and preserve source/object readbacks. Probe cannot independently see hidden host backing. A preexisting host basename refuses admission; never delete it.
isolation_and_bounds.exclusive_creation: First sem_open uses O_CREAT|O_EXCL,mode0600,value0. First NULL/EEXIST records failure without ownership and never unlinks. Second exclusive open of this probe's own existing semaphore must fail EEXIST; a returned handle is checked-close then fails the run.
isolation_and_bounds.nonblocking: Exactly three sem_trywait calls and one sem_post. No sem_wait, timed/blocking wait, recursion, shell, subprocess, retries or service loop. Every unexpected return/errno fails.
isolation_and_bounds.cleanup: Only a handle created by successful first exclusive open can be closed/unlinked. After close return failure or exception, unlink is attempted independently, conditioned on saved backing dev/ino, regular type, effective UID and single link. Missing/unproved identity or changed backing means no unlink and FAILED. No provider artifact cleanup.
isolation_and_bounds.cleanup_assumption: Fresh private0700 filesystem, fresh token and no concurrent untrusted writer for this single-process probe are required. libc sem_unlink is name-based; the lstat-to-unlink identity check is not a whole-system race-proof claim against a malicious same-UID host actor.
isolation_and_bounds.footprint: Existing output32MiB/1024inode budget is shared; no new mount or quota. One semaphore backing32bytes on pinned ABI, one20byte regular witness, one result<=8192bytes, bounded tool stdout<=8192bytes. Deliberate socket mode adds only its own closed socket pathname.
isolation_and_bounds.source_bounds: libc hash at most16MiB+1read byte; mountinfo<=65536bytes/512lines/2048characters per line; UID/GID maps<=256bytes each; paths<=1024characters; error strings<=512characters; all loops over constants or admitted bounded data.
isolation_and_bounds.deadline: Collector owns original180second tool/220second collector/240second outer limits, own scope, original memory/swap/reserve/admission and cleanup. Probe itself has no wait or deadline extension.
isolation_and_bounds.quota_controls: verification_path owns separate ipc-cap-controls child entry point in ram_qualification_v4.py. No import/exec of collector source from this probe and no circular source hash.

abi.prototypes: CDLL fixed absolute libc path,use_errno=True. sem_open.argtypes=[c_char_p,c_int], restype=c_void_p; explicit c_uint(mode),c_uint(value) for variadic arguments; NULL/None is the installed SEM_FAILED. sem_trywait/post/close(c_void_p)->c_int and sem_unlink(c_char_p)->c_int. errno captured immediately after meaningful failure returns.
abi.rationale: ctypes avoids an additional compiled helper/build and limits the native boundary to five declared libc APIs. Explicit types and pinned ABI reduce calling-convention uncertainty; they do not prove Python,libffi,libc or the kernel.
